mcp_tools.name: electrical_test_record_preparation
mcp_tools.title: Electrical test record preparation
mcp_tools.description: Submit a test-record evidence manifest (test sheet, data hygiene, readings with declared acceptance criteria, machine-readable format, trending and plotting discipline, retention/audit record); get a deterministic RECORD_READY / RECORD_NOT_READY / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE verdict across six sections, including computed readings-vs-criteria and declared-verdict consistency checks, with per-check evidence.

inputSchema.description: The test-record evidence manifest (see the atom's SERVICE.md for the field table and reading schema).

hygiene.description: Data-hygiene evidence (raw data preserved, corrections via dated revision notes).

readings.description: Declared readings: {point, value, unit, acceptance_min, acceptance_max}.

plotting.description: Plotting-discipline evidence (labeled axes, version+date, no dual-axis charts).

expect.notes: All checks pass. Computed spot checks: readings_evaluated=1, readings_out_of_criteria=0.
